scientific_integrity: The displayed quadratic-space counts are classical inputs, not claimed as new. This package supplies its complete specific algebra subalgebra spectrum and growing-dimension distributional theorem; no independent review has occurred.
scientific_limitations: Odd prime powers only; B nonsingular and symmetric; unital embedded F_q-linear subalgebras only; asymptotics fixed q. Finite computation is corroboration, not a proof. A relevant 1975 nilpotent-algebra subalgebra enumeration article was not available for full comparison, so publication priority is provisional.
title: Subalgebra spectra and Witt detection in quadratic Artinian Gorenstein algebras
